title: Aaj zehra ki shaadi Rachi hai
body:
Aaj zehra ki shaadi Rachi hai
Dhoom ahmed ke ghar me machi hain
Aaj zahra ki shaadi rachi hain...x2
Marhaba kaisi mehfil saji hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj...x3
Boli qudrat jina ko saja do
Nare dozakh ko jaldi  bhuja do
Fatema aaj dulhan bani hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj...x2
Aadam o Nuh late hain sehra
Aur Dawood gaate hain sehra
Daste Haidar me mehendi lagi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj..x2
Puche Sara O Mariyam kaha hain
Bole Hawwa ke dono yaha hain
Puri jannat yah aa gayi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj..x2
Khush bohot hain khuda ka payambar
Par hain aankhon me ashkon ke sagar
Ke khatija ki yaad aa gayi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj..x2
Aaj Jibreel hain raah khade hain
Leke kya jaaon yeh sochte hain
Wahi toh khud utarne lagi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj..x2
Kashtiyan saj rahi hain najati
Aayatein ban rahi hain barati
Hamd leke alam chal rahi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj...x2
Yeh kaneezon ne aake kahi baat
Aao dekhe hain nazdeek barat
Ya Ali ki sada aa rahi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj..x2
Rat jagah Surahe Qadr kar le
Noor daman me bal fajr bhar le
Innama ko taharat mili hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj..x2
Kehdo suraj se bhi door jaye
Kardo aylaan woh woh na aye
Aag jis jis ke bhi lag rahi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj..x2
Chand sharma raha hain bichara
Bait e zahra me hain husn saara
Har taraf roshni roshni hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj...x2
Likho Maajid khushi ke fasane
Shadman tum sunao tarane
Yeh payambar ke ghar ki khusi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj...x3
author: Shadman Raza
